cohort: The study participants were women admitted to a tertiary care facility during or after pregnancy, birth, or up to 42 days following an abortion due to complications.
finding: Out of 120 maternal cases (10 fatalities, 110 near misses), significant associations were found with booking status, mode of delivery, ICU stays, uric acid, potassium, haemoglobin levels, and types of organ dysfunction and surgical interventions, while maternal age, gestational age, OBS scores, birth weight, timing of events, and referral status were not significantly related to maternal outcomes.
mod_finding: Better maternal outcomes were associated with booking and Lower Segment Caesarean Section (LSCS).
followup_time: up to 42 days after birth or abortion (or until release/death from hospital)
birth_weight: Included (as a variable that did not show significant relationship)
gest_age: Included (as a variable that did not show significant relationship)
